description: What relates to one stored item. ref: Message-ID or URL, commit SHA or URL, docs URL or page, wiki URL or title, commitfest URL, CVE-YYYY-NNNNN (ref.advisory: the security page's row, fixed releases; or status not-a-vulnerability), or feature:<words>. Related threads, commits (releases, reverted_by), docs, wiki pages, entries and people, each with why, strongest first; timeline (status and dated events) for a commit, thread, entry or feature; graph (design-history facts with confidence) for features and entries. ~3 s budget (late parts in timed_out). Same as GET /api/v2/related.
name: cross_reference
